tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the documentation by keyword or phrase. Returns a ranked list of matching pages with relevant excerpts.

query.description: Search query — keywords or phrase to find in the documentation

section.description: Filter results to a specific documentation section

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 25)

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a documentation page by its slug or URL path. Returns the page as markdown.

slug.description: Page slug or URL path (e.g. "getting-started" or "api/authentication")

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the documentation structure showing all sections and their page counts. Use this to discover what documentation is available before searching.

section.description: Filter to a specific section's children by section name
